title: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
description: Crisp-edged oven sweet potato fries tossed with a little cornstarch and smoked paprika, baked in a single layer until golden.

image.alt: Orange sweet potato fries on a sheet pan with a dipping sauce

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven} and line the baking sheets with parchment.
Pat the sweet potato sticks dry. Toss them with the cornstarch in a large bowl until lightly dusted, then add the oil and toss again.
Spread them in a single layer across both sheets with space between; crowded fries steam and go soft.
Bake for {time 15 min}, flip, and bake until browned and crisp at the edges, {time 10-15 min} more.
Toss the hot fries with the paprika, garlic powder and salt and serve right away.

notes: Sweet potato fries never get quite as crisp as regular fries, but thin, even cuts and plenty of space get them close.
